bayts.text: In the Name of God, from Whom the Qurʾān has descended, (is) my beginning, and I hope for His hospitality (of Paradise).
Glory be to a generous Lord Who has granted me, out of generosity, to cling to a Qurʾān whose guidance has shone forth.
Whoever is for Allah, Allah — exalted be He — is for him; and whoever has sought nearness to Him through al-Māḥī (Muḥammad) has been accepted.
O Allah, bless with a peace beyond number him, with the Family, the Companions and the excellent ones.
To Allah I have repented again, and He forgives me my sin and veils my fault through the one who has been preferred.
To Him (goes) my discourse, and His answer comes to me, in this world and the next, and I seek no substitute in exchange for Him.
Grant me my aspirations, O Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), without toil, and spare me, through the Messenger of Allah, every affliction.
You alone I ask, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), that I be, in my world, a servant, an attendant who has gathered gifts.
Be lavish to me with knowledge and with striving joined to good conduct; spare me the breaking of the covenant, and heal my ills for me.
Subdue the creatures for me, and drive to me what I wish, forever, without any hidden guile, and spare me shame.
Shield me from evil and draw good things to me, all together, and spare me disgrace, turbidity and fear.
Make my right hand and my heart masters of that through which I may be like the sea, in generosity and outpouring, and spare me sloth.
Make all that will be mine, forever, a help toward doing what You have chosen for me as work.
Cleanse my person of all impurities, every one, and spare me everything that brings disorder.
You are the Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), by Whose mercy I hope, on the Day of Resurrection, for glad tidings: fulfil the hope!
Grant me, by the rank of the Messenger of Allah, our master, not to be called to account on the Day that lays bare the missteps.
I have hoped for many times what Harim (ibn Sinān) gave to Zuhayr (ibn Abī Sulmā), for my praise of the best of those who have bestowed (gifts).
I have praised You today, O You Who have no partner: so perfect me through it, like the assembly of the perfect.
O Lord, bless with a peace beyond number him whose being the best of creatures has been understood.
